title: Stat Sheet
description:
Hit thuh whistle key (Default: P) ta cahwl yo-wr hoss ta ya, settin' it ta follow.  Hit thuh same key while ridin' yo-wr hoss t' fetch uhp thuh [Horse Info Screen](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/horse_stats.png:140:112).  This will show ya yo-wr hoss's gender, breed, an coat, which ahr mostly for breeding, along with its bond, speed, jump height, an bacon.
Bond is an important stat t' keep trayck awf.  Every 20 points, yo-wr hoss's speed an jump heaahyt increase.  Hp, not so much.  It'll increases slowly jus' by standin' nar 'em, but nuh-amin' 'em will add 10 points, eend feedin' 'em a golden apple will give 2.
hit thuh Manage Horses key (Default: G) ta fetch uhp [a list awf all yo-wr horses](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/manage_horses.png:220:100).  It'll show ya where ther, let ya whistle for 'em, sey-nd 'em home ifin' thay 'ave one, set 'em as active, or disown 'em.  Ifin' a hoss is marked as "resting" the-yn it's ary in another dimension or thuh chunk is unloaded.
